A.title: Three-column bookshelf
A.requirements: 1200 mm wide, 1800 mm high, 300 mm deep. Three columns with three shelves each, a plinth at the bottom and a 6 mm back panel.

B.title: Cabinet with a door and two drawers
B.requirements: 900 mm wide, 800 mm high, 580 mm deep. Left bay: a hinged door. Right bay: two drawers.

C.title: Wall shelf
C.requirements: A 600 mm wide, 200 mm deep shelf that is screwed to the wall, held by two triangular brackets.

D.title: Toy car
D.requirements: A 200 mm long wooden toy car with four wheels on axles and a rounded roof.
